description: This file contains platform hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions for device configuration, system info retrieval, and hardware control, including network settings, memory info, and temperature/fan control.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a shell command and retrieves the first line of output, parsing for ':' character.
